reviews.text: Wonderful experience. Danny was amazing and so good with my baby. Made him look so good and smelled so nice. Definitely recommend!

DO NOT TRUST THIS GROOMER. My dog was injured during a grooming and the groomer did not share that it happened. He simply handed my dog to me in my arms saying nothing, so it wasn't until after he left and I put my dog on the ground to walk that I noticed he was limping and very out of it. I contacted the office to find out what happened and they have yet to share any updates with me 3 days later even after multiple photos, a $330 vet visit, and follow up messages since. It seems they may filter through a call center, so even though the person that answered the phone was very nice - they had absolutely no authority or access to information to share details to resolve the issue and I haven't heard from management at all. In addition to the injury, I suspect the groomer may have given my dog something because he was VERY out of it. Whatever you do STAY AWAY FROM MIAMI PET GROOMING.

I am very disappointed with the service I received. I had a scheduled appointment, and they arrived an hour and a half late with no consideration for my time. Furthermore, the final price was not the same as the initial quote, which I found opaque and unprofessional. I spoke with the manager to try to reach an amicable solution, but he was incredibly rude and even insulted me.
Because of this experience, I will not use their services again for any of my three dogs. I also regret having recommended this business to my two cousins, who will also no longer be clients due to the lack of respect and professionalism shown. I hope you take this feedback as an opportunity to improve your punctuality, communication, and customer service.

Two bookings.
One 90-minute delay.
One complete no-show.

The explanation? “Internal error” and a scripted apology.

This isn’t bad luck—it’s poor operations.

If your time matters, don’t rely on them.

Jocelyn did a fantastic job with my sweet Ragdoll kitty. His fur is very hard to deal with and gets matted very easily if he’s not brushed everyday. She got all the matts off and left him clean and fresh. He seemed just fine when she returned him to me so he mush have not been scared or upset through the grooming process. She obviously was very sweet with him and patient. I told her to take her time and she did, she did a fantastic job.

Jose is an amazing person not only has groomer but as a human being, he is sweet, caring, treats our Layla like the princess she is. He is the BEST!

José has been grooming all 6 of our fur babies for years. I have referred him to my family members whom also groom with him. He’s the family groomer and we are so thankful for the love and attention he gives our babies. Jose is extremely accommodating, kind, patient, and loving to our babies. We have 6 in our home alone but between cousins and the rest of the clan we’re about 10 dogs and we love Jose 🥰
Horrible service

Jose has been our trusted groomer for the past 5 years at least. we met him when he started grooming our senior dog chip who has since gone on to doggy heaven and we trust him with our new pup Teddy who gives him a hard time on occasion. He's always been nothing but caring and loving with our fur babies and recommend him whenebr we can with no reservations.

I can’t say enough good things about our groomer, Jose F! From the moment he arrives, he treats my pup with so much love, patience, and care. The attention to detail is amazing my dog always comes back looking adorable, clean, and happy (which says everything about how comfortable he makes the experience).

You can truly tell he cares about the animals, not just the service. Professional, gentle, and reliable every time. The convenience of the mobile service makes everything even better. If you’re looking for someone you can trust with your fur baby, I highly recommend Miami Pet Grooming and Jose F as your groomer.

José has been the most caring and knowledgeable groomer we have ever had. He took care of our aging dog Chip and now our new pup Teddy. He’s the only person we trust and he always does an amazing job. Hands down the best!

Jose does an excellent job grooming my Giant Schnauzer, Tito. He owns two miniature schnauzers himself, so he truly understands the breed and how to properly care for their coats.

He’s attentive, patient, and always takes the time to make sure Tito is comfortable. Tito is genuinely happy to see him every time — and that level of trust speaks for itself.

Highly recommend.

We have been with Jose for years, and there is truly no one else we would trust with our babies. He has been grooming Pochy (our Yorkie), Blanca (our Maltese), and Mindy (our Morkie) since they were just tiny puppies. Now our dog family has grown to include Novalee, our Aussiedoodle, and of course she is in the best hands with him too.

Jose has honestly become part of our family. We trust him blindly with our furry babies, and that says everything. He is not only an incredibly skilled and professional groomer, but he genuinely loves our dogs — and it shows every single time. They are always happy to see him and come back looking beautiful, clean, and well cared for.

His attention to detail, patience, and kindness set him apart. You can tell this isn’t just a job for him — he truly cares. We are beyond grateful for the love and care he gives Pochy, Blanca, Mindy, and Novalee. Five stars isn’t enough!

Jose keeps our 3 fur babies looking gorgeous. They love him and he takes great care of them. He is extremely knowledgeable aboit different breeds of dogs and what works best for their particular coats. Jose is the best!
Jose F was great with Max! He came out super cute!
Jose f is such a fantastic groomer. He takes care of the pets and makes sure they are comfortable. The groom was perfect.

Jose is an amazing groomer!! He always groomed my fur babies beautiful and always come on time to our appts.
He is the best!!

I can’t say enough great things about Jose—he is truly an amazing dog groomer! He always does an outstanding job bathing my two French bulldogs, Bentley and Chloe. Every time he’s done bathing them, they look and smell incredible, and most importantly, they’re happy, calm, and clearly well cared for.

Jose takes the time to treat Bentley and Chloe with so much patience and kindness, and it genuinely shows how much he cares about the animals he works with. He is extremely passionate about his job, and that passion comes through in the quality of his work and the way he handles my dogs. I always feel confident and at ease knowing they are in such great hands.

If you’re looking for someone who goes above and beyond and truly loves what he does, Jose is the groomer you want. I wouldn’t trust my dogs with anyone else!

I will definitely be using them again

Yusleidy is absolutely amazing! We have a 15-year-old Maltese who still has plenty of youthful energy, and she handles him with so much care, patience, and love. It’s clear she truly enjoys what she does and treats every dog like her own.

She’s also a great communicator. Even if you’re not bilingual, she goes the extra mile and uses Google Translate to make sure everything is clearly understood, which we really appreciate.

We actually chose to wait for her return from vacation rather than book with someone else—that’s how much we trust her! She’s consistently friendly, professional, and genuinely grateful for her clients (and always so appreciative of tips).

If you’re looking for someone who is skilled, kind, and truly cares about your pet, Yusleidy is the one. Highly recommend! 🐾

Yusleidy has been grooming my 2 pups for a few years now.  She is amazing and always fits my schedule ! The dogs always come out so cute, she does an amazing job styling and grooming the pups,when she does  the dental cleaning they come out with brand new teeth and great breath , highly recommend

I'm leaving a bad review after some good experiences, but this last one was awful from beginning to end. They sent a man to cut my dog's hair, and he clearly had no idea what he was doing. (I should have trusted my gut.) However, I gave him a chance and explained what we wanted. In the end, the result was mediocre, but the worst part is that he hurt my dog's ear, stomach, and tail. He hurt his ear so badly that it bled, cleaned it up, and didn't say anything until we realized what had happened. This person showed absolutely no care or professionalism. I recently booked a grooming appointment with Miami’s Pet Grooming, and unfortunately, I was very disappointed with the service. Jocelyn, the groomer, did a fine job with the haircut itself, but I paid $100 for a wash and cut, and my dog clearly did NOT receive a bath.

I’ve used mobile grooming services many times, and after a proper wash the van area is usually wet, and my dog always comes out slightly damp. This time, everything was completely dry, and my dog wasn’t moist at all. Instead, he came back in an extremely strong perfume from head to toe — it was overpowering and honestly concerning. It really felt like they skipped the bath entirely and just covered him with fragrance.

I paid for a full wash and cut, but I only received a cut. Beware of this company — it seems they may be skipping the bathing portion and masking it with perfume. Very disappointing and not what I paid for.

I’ve been using this mobile pet grooming company for my Maltipoo, and Daniella is wonderful. My dog is usually aggressive, but he’s completely comfortable with her. Prices are reasonable, and the convenience of having the grooming done right outside my apartment is unbeatable. The company owns the grooming trucks and employs multiple groomers, so if you’re flexible, it’s easy to find an open time slot. The only drawback is that it can feel like luck of the draw until you find a groomer you really like — but once you do, you can request them specifically. Booking online is simple, the text reminders are very helpful. You communicate with the groomer through the schedulers which has been easy and reliable. You can text the schedulers with any specifications. I’ve had other groomers before, but Daniella is the one my dog loves, so now I always book with her.

After reaching out to several mobile grooming services, I went back to the OG, Ernesto’s Pet Grooming, however he doesn’t service the DT area. He did recommend MPG and I’m so grateful he did! First, because so many people wouldn’t recommend or even mention another service provider in their industry and secondly, he has groomed my pups for several years and I have always been satisfied with his service. Highly recommend him if you’re in the Kendall area.

MPG doesn’t have top tier reviews on yelp and after sifting through people’s complaints, it’s mostly tom foolery— at least to me it is.

What I look for is a grooming service who is patient, kind and gentle. I have an old girl (she is 19, blind, and even more nervous about baths/haircuts than ever before— expected at her age). I get more nervous than her sometimes, lol.
The groomer was delayed but communication was great. Although you don’t directly talk to the groomer, you talk to the grooming service agent who then communicates with the groomer,  I prefer direct communication. But, that’s the way this business is built.

I met Daniela and she was so sweet and nice. She understood all of my reservations and that I was ultimately looking for my pup to get a groom that will last for a while since the groomers stress her out too much.

I am extremely satisfied with the outcome. While my old girl looks a lot older with less hair (her age is definitely showing now, lol) it’s needed and she seemed to tolerate it well.

I will definitely be coming back to Daniela and I highly recommend her if you’re in the DT area.

Price was fair as well— $78 for a bath, haircut, nails, sanitary, and ears. No teeth cleaning for this pup.

Hope this helps you all who are looking for a straight forward grooming service! If you’re looking for some Westminster Dog show grooming, not sure if this is the place for that lol

I asked them to trim her nicely like the back of her (before her tail) and this is what they did. The original price was 160 because she weigh more than 70 pounds and because of her breed. Today I sit here writing this review with great sadness. Firstly I would never write a review to hurt a business. But I'm writing this as a precaution .I had the worst experience with this company yes it took me about 3 months to write it because I really thought about it. On August 9 2024 this company came and groomed my dog Rosie I would like to say Rosie had a vision problem before hand which was mentioned to the groomer. Anyway Rosie was groomed but later on at night I've notice her being uncomfortable and blinking alot mind you this was on a Friday by Wednesday her eye was super red and what appeared to be blood by Friday her eye was bulging like a pug on Saturday I took her to the vet and the vet informed me she  Rosie needed her eye removed immediately she had suffer trauma that was so bad that she needed an emergency surgery. I called them and told them the situation that my dog was hurt by there groomer NO ONE HAD THE DECENCY TO CALL ME BACK! on Tuesday I had my dog go into surgery Again I called them and Again no one called me back .when I first called them it was to warn them about the incident. Thank God I had Miami Dade Animal shelter that helped me with the surgery because my dog would had died if she did get the surgery. DO YOU WANT TO KNOW WHEN THEY CALLED ME? THEY CALLED ME WHEN I THREATENED TO GO PUBLIC WITH THIS INCIDENT! Then I had them call me .Firstly they said they had cameras in there van which is a lie.then they had some other person call me .at the end no one took responsibility even trying to get off by saying oh you should have called us the same day,or what makes you sure it happened with us? BTW the groomer that groomed Rosie left,the so called cameras had no results.i have my vet that performed the surgery and it's reports states surgery due to trauma which has nothing to do with her vision problems. I will state they gave Rosie a bed ,a bag of food and treats but thinking about it, it was more of shut up and leaves us alone type of thing.when I told them hey give me refund due to you guys almost killing my dog they responded with we paid the groomer and can't give you a refund nor the day we took off running around trying to save my dog life due to there negligence or even refund to my vets bill.i personally take it as a slap in the face! They even tried victim shaming me.anyway here I sit with my blind dog with out an eye and scared to take her to a groomer. I almost lost my dog because of them.please becareful because they also admitted to a similar incident with another dog.please beware I 100% regret not taking legal action against them .I do have reports stating everything I've said is true including messages between them and I to prove I'm not lying becareful with them.again I'm posting this for you not to risk your pets my dog was nearly dead because of there negligence. And yes I will post this in social media to warn people. If anyone wants to reach out I could show you the vets report and messages text and voice to prove I'm not lying .becareful with your pets please beware of this company.
